alex: Quick poll — what am I watching tonight? A) The Expanse with ambient/synth space score (think Cliff Martinez) B) Twin Peaks (Angelo Badalamenti vibes) — want something immersive. :thinking_face:

tanya: If you want both, try 'The OA' + Twin Peaks soundtrack energy, very uncanny.
emma: I'm team Twin Peaks. Also recommend listening on headphones and dimming lights. :headphones:
